finalText:
Wrote the 4.2.0 section into `CHANGELOG.md`.

Of 380 commits, 14 matter to users. Three are breaking: the v1 export route is gone, internal error types are no longer re-exported, and an expired token now returns 401 not 403. One feature: webhook retry with backoff.

I left the perf work out to keep your three headings. Say the word if you want it.
